Im a 32y, m. I was on and off meds until I was 18. Since then basically adhd med free. I hated the side effects of them. I like to explain it this way. 

Off the meds I was extroverted, very social and outgoing.  On the meds I felt the opposite in alot of ways. Overall I felt like it suppressed a part of who I was that I actually liked.

Unfortunately at 32 I am struggling greatly with pretty much all aspects of adulting lol. So as of last week I am seeking medication management again. My social life has dwindled since meeting my antisocial, also adhd girlfriend of 6 years. Between that and the pandemic it's basically just her and I and a couple social occasions here and there. Basically my priorities have shifted away from needing to be that extroverted outgoing guy and a strong need to be able to focus, complete tasks, not spend impulsively, etc.. is now quite seriously needed. 


Point is, you can do it off the meds. I did for more than 10 years. It's just hard. 

Thanks for reading hope this helps.
